e: The III International Congress of Armenian Studies takes place at the Matenadaran, dedicated to the 350th anniversary of Mkhitar Sebastatsi.
The Armenian government allocates 63,735,000 drams to host the III International Congress of Armenian Studies.
Russia bans the importation of fish from all but two processing plants in Armenia.
The Eurasian Economic Union called on Armenia to hold a referendum regarding the initiation of the process to join the EU and whether or not to continue its membership in the EAEU.
Russia bans the import of Jermuk mineral water, two brands of wine and one brand of cognac from Armenia.
Turkey lifts restrictions on direct trade with Armenia.
The first bilateral summit between Armenia and the European Union is held in Yerevan.
JD Vance arrives in Yerevan as the first US vice president to visit Armenia.
The United States and Armenia sign an agreement on civil nuclear cooperation.
